sloka: अभिलक्षेण तीव्रेण कुम्भेन निशितैः शरैः।आचितास्ते द्रुमा रेजुर्यथा घोराः शतघ्नयः ।। ६.७६.६८ ।।
transliteration: abhilakṣeṇa tīvreṇa kumbhena niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ।ācitāste drumā rejuryathā ghorāḥ śataghnayaḥ ।। 6.76.68 ।।

translations.english: The sharp arrows aimed at the target by Kumbha covered the trees and they shone like dreadful Sataghnis.
